notes: ZOMBIES (new): a ZOMBIES tab on the main menu takes you to its own lobby. No loadout: everyone starts with the Service 9 pistol, 2 frags and 500 points.
Survive round after round. Zombies walk at first, jog from round 3 and run from round 6, and get tougher every round.
Points: 10 a hit, 60 a kill, 100 a headshot kill, 130 a melee kill.
Mystery Crate (950 points) gives a random gun. Ammo Crate (250 points) refills your ammo. Press USE at a crate to buy.
Pick a map in the zombies lobby (LB / RB changes it) or leave it on RANDOM. Your best round is saved.
